narrative.iNeed: to project Content Security Policies, validate loopback network bindings, and classify route dispatch requests
narrative.soThat: the query console executes within established security and operational boundary policies

scenarios.title: Project query console Content Security Policy
given: The query console security policy adapter is initialized
then: The defined Content Security Policy header value is returned
scenarios.observableResult: The query console receives the CSP header policy restricting frame, script, and object sources
scenarios.conformanceSignal: projectsCspPolicy executes semantic authority bundle and projects cspPolicy value

scenarios.title: Classify loopback bind request
given: A network bind request specifying host 127.0.0.1 is supplied
then: The request is classified as an admitted loopback address
scenarios.observableResult: The network binding host is confirmed as admitted loopback interface
scenarios.conformanceSignal: classifiesLoopbackBind executes semantic authority bundle and validates loopback host admission

scenarios.title: Classify HTTP route dispatch request
given: An incoming HTTP request specifying route pathname and method is received
then: The request maps to a recognized route identifier
scenarios.observableResult: The request is dispatched to the corresponding route handler identifier
scenarios.conformanceSignal: classifiesRoute executes semantic authority bundle and emits mapped routeId

obligations.statement: Project the Content Security Policy header string for query console runtime
Validate loopback bind requests against admitted hostname constraints
Classify HTTP request pathname and method combinations into query console route identifiers

queryEvidence.commandText: SELECT bm.mechanic AS mechanic, bm.modulePath AS modulePath, sym.name AS symbolName, sr.startLine AS startLine, sr.endLine AS endLine FROM bodyMechanics bm JOIN sourceReferences sr ON bm.sourceReferenceId = sr.referenceId LEFT JOIN symbols sym ON bm.fromSymbolId = sym.symbolId WHERE bm.mechanic = 'object-construction' ORDER BY bm.modulePath, sr.startLine

modelAssessment.rationale: The query console boundary policies feature is fully specified by three semantic authority modules covering CSP projection, loopback bind classification, and route dispatch classification.
